about: A package's format file that names a format and also defines the same name in its own $defs (chapter 2 § 2.3; ruled by the owner on #1508). The format visit names the package format timing; the input visit is of it. Invalid: visit.json's own definition is named timing. Valid: it is named own_timing.
sentences: Format 'visit' names format 'timing' and also defines 'timing' in its own $defs. Rename the definition or remove it.
